notes: PAP reference G36/1951. Private-owner T3 in Caen's La Folie-Couvrechef district. The full advert describes a bright 66 m2 through-apartment on the first floor of a calm secure three-storey condominium, with a lift renewed in 2022, digicode and intercom. It includes an entrance with fitted storage, south-east-facing living room opening through a large window onto a balcony, equipped kitchen, two bright bedrooms, separate dressing room, bathroom, separate WC and a healthy 5 m2 cellar. Shared facilities include a large bicycle room and plentiful free residence parking. The advert places it near the CHU, Memorial, schools, shops, employers and public transport. It states DPE D from June 2026 and explicitly says the apartment is sold free of occupation. The detail page exposed twelve property photos; the retained URL is the first source photo.

PAP reference G35/1799. Private-owner two-room character apartment near Place Saint-Sauveur in Caen. The full advert describes 55 m2 on the second floor of an older building with very low charges, high ceilings, original features, fireplaces and a view of the Abbaye aux Hommes. The layout comprises a large bright equipped kitchen used as a living area, a spacious sitting room with fireplace, a corridor with fitted storage and one quiet courtyard-facing bedroom. Double glazing and extensive integrated storage are stated. The property is near shops, restaurants and Caen's historic centre. The detail page exposed six property photos; the retained URL is the first source photo. No DPE letter, exact charge amount or property-tax amount was exposed in accessible text.
